parent_objective: design perturbation-scale and window diagnostic for fresh boundary sampling

public_gates: design compares perturbation scales before objective design
design compares snapshot/window targets before objective design
design reports normal-failed too-safe and sensitivity ratios
design blocks actor update PPO and promotion
design preserves P0 actor input contract
forbidden_shortcuts: do not call large action overrides a deployable policy
do not accept threshold loosening as source-positive without scale diagnostics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_source_scale: diagnose windowing and perturbation scale for terminal-boundary source mining
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a no-training sensitivity-scale diagnostic after M698 fresh sampling produced no accepted rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic design only, not source success, objective training, PPO, or promotion
stop_condition: stop if design cannot distinguish plausible local perturbations from unrealistic overrides
stop before objective design unless a later implementation finds accepted rows at registered plausible scales
stop if the diagnostic would simply loosen thresholds on the same metrics
fallback_plan: if larger plausible scales still produce no sensitivity, pivot to scenario construction or base capability improvement
if only unrealistic scales produce sensitivity, do not admit objective design
if plausible scales produce rows, audit before objective design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: after scale diagnostic implementation and audit, or earlier if no evaluated rows are produced

hypothesis: A registered window and perturbation-scale diagnostic can determine whether M698 was empty because the perturbations/window were too conservative or because the base-policy distribution lacks local terminal-boundary sensitivity.
success_criteria: design defines plausible and stress perturbation scales
design defines per-scale acceptance and rejection metrics
objective actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
failure_criteria: design only loosens thresholds without scale reporting
design admits objective training before source-positive evidence
design omits normal-failed or too-safe accounting
decision_rule: M700 is design-only and passes if it defines a no-training sensitivity-scale diagnostic with objective actor update PPO and promotion blocked.
